Shown while LightDecoder is connected to WhatsApp, with a button to disconnect.
WhatsApp messages
New messages that arrive through the WhatsApp link.
Link WhatsApp
Use WhatsApp in LightDecoder
LightDecoder can join your WhatsApp account as a linked device, the way WhatsApp Web does, so your chats show up here next to your other messages and you can answer them.

On a debug build, anyone who connects this phone to a computer with USB debugging (adb) can read LightDecoder\'s WhatsApp archive and the keys of the link. Use it with a test account only, never your own.
This is not an official WhatsApp client

LightDecoder is not made or approved by WhatsApp. It talks to WhatsApp the way WhatsApp Web does, which WhatsApp\'s terms do not allow for other apps. WhatsApp can end the link at any time, and it can restrict or ban an account that uses unofficial apps. Only link an account you are prepared to take that risk with.
What is stored on this phone

The keys of the link, your chats, messages and the pictures and files you open are kept in LightDecoder\'s private storage on this phone. Nothing is uploaded anywhere, and nothing is included in backups. Unlinking deletes the keys; you choose whether the messages go too.
You confirm on your own phone
Linking only happens when you type a code into WhatsApp on your phone, or scan a QR code with it, yourself. LightDecoder cannot do that step for you and never tries to.
How to stop
While connected, LightDecoder always shows a notification with a Disconnect button. You can unlink in the link\'s settings here, or in WhatsApp on your phone under Linked devices, at any time.

Enter this code on your phone

1. Open WhatsApp on your phone.
2. Go to Settings, then Linked devices.
3. Tap Link a device.
4. Tap "Link with phone number instead".
5. Enter the code above.
